card.name: Commas inside statin drug lists
card.fires_on: The comma (or 'and') between statin names in lists of HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors, such as atorvastatin, fluvastatin, pravastatin. Also fires partway through the brand name ZYPITAMAG.
